messages:
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty: HIGH - inference-api (prod) 5xx spike in az1a (us-west-2a). Alert: prod.inference.5xx_rate > 5% for 5m. Link: https://alerts.company/INC-8392
carla_oncall: seeing it, joining. logs look like a mix of econnreset and grpc stream resets.
alice_sre: confirming. DNAT to nlb in az1a shows elevated connection queue and retransmits. Latency tail up ~400ms, 504s at ~6%.
ben_runtime: rolling diagnostics: kv-cache miss rate spiked at 11:12:03 UTC, correlated with resolver timeouts. Could be resolver/backoff.
eve_network: checking resolver queries -> spike to our resolver endpoint 10.23.4.5 with 30% dropped responses from the local AZ resolver pool.
frank_enginfra: oncall note: AZ control plane reports degraded health for a subset of instances (eni attach churn reported). Instances not shutting down, but kernel rx scheduling jitter seen.
carla_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) Enable regional fallback for routing policy (steer new requests away from az1a) 2) Increase retry budget for short window 3) Enable model-variant fallback to smaller model in az1a to reduce per-token load. Executing now.
ben_runtime: executed routing rule change: updated smart-routing policy -> avoid az1a for traffic class=interactive. Propagation took ~25s.
incident-bot: Smart routing change applied by carla_oncall. Old policy backed up at config 2026-03-17T11:14Z.
dan_support: open support ticket queue shows ~18 customers reporting degraded responses, 3 customers reporting timeouts on inference jobs >60s. Tagging CS for prioritized comms.
alice_sre: temporary measures: increased NLB connection draining timeout to 120s and disabled connection stickiness for new flows to avoid sharks. Also triggered additional ephemeral replacement instances in az1b.
eve_network: we pushed a resolver endpoint failover to alternate resolver pool (us-west-2-resolver-b). Confirming dropped response rate fell to normal within 40s.
ben_runtime: kvcache warmup is ongoing; miss rate falling. Error rate across global fleet fell from 6% -> 1.4% after route steer. Latency p50 stable, p95 trending down.
frank_enginfra: digging into instance metrics: affected host NIC queue length shows periodic saturation coincident with a controlplane heartbeat backlog. Filing followup with cloud provider.
carla_oncall: pausing pager escalation. If error rate stays <2% for 10m, we'll move to monitoring and customer outreach.
dan_support: drafting customer note: short disruption in us-west-2a causing increased latency/5xx for some inference requests; mitigation in place, recommending customers retry. Will send to accounts flagged.
eve_network: note for postmortem: verify resolver healthchecks across AZs and consider adding headroom to resolver endpoints for inference controlplane flows.
ben_runtime: suggestion: add a transient kv-cache prewarm on routing failover to reduce cold-miss spike. Adding to short-term runbook.
alice_sre: logging follow-up items: - escalate to cloud provider with packet captures and ENI timings - assess autoscaler hysteresis that delayed replacement capacity - validate kvcache eviction thresholds under high miss storm
carla_oncall: handing off to alice_sre for long-term investigation. alice_oncall assume? @alice_sre you are primary for the post-incident. I'll remain on standby. :white_check_mark:
alice_sre: taking it. Will start a post-incident doc and ping infra for provider escalation.
incident-bot: Incident wave closed to P1, downgraded to P2 at 3932110200.
carla_oncall: final status: regional routing fallback applied, resolver failover executed, ephemeral capacity added, customer comms drafted. Monitoring for 30m then postmortem. :thumbsup:
